  competitive fronts in vWD and MPN. Net: -1.

  high $132.6) helps talent retention and gives M&A currency (the Vega deal
  was done in stock+cash). A weak price would make the pipeline harder to fund
  and the buyback less efficient. Mild positive reflexivity at current levels.
Step 3.5-3. Customer behavior: Hematology patients are chronic/sticky (high
  retention); the early-adopter→mainstream transition for Opzelura (AD) and
  Niktimvo (GVHD) is the growth engine. LTV is high, CAC is amortized over a
  large installed base; churn is low. This supports the margin-expansion
